pages.text: $(thing)Farms$(): Resource. Needs $(item)Applied Energistics 2$().$(br2)Does the AE2 Inscriber's job inside a farm. It is crafted with, and turns back into, an AE2 Inscriber.$(br2)$(thing)Grinding$(): with the card, a Sky Stone farm makes sky dust and a Certus Quartz farm makes certus quartz dust.

$(thing)Pressing$(): gold ore farms make logic processor prints, diamond ore farms engineering processor prints and the silicon farm silicon prints, but only with the matching $(item)press$() in the farm's $(item)press slot$().$(br2)The press slot is the last slot on the Resource Farm's Upgrades screen. The press is not consumed.
